title: AURA harmony document (the Composer, Plan H1)
description: The Composer's harmony document: `tick -> key` and `tick -> chord`, a map pair parallel to the tempo and meter maps (ruling H-3). Source of truth: `src-tauri/src/theory/harmony.rs`; the persisted form is the additive `harmony` key in project.json, written by `midi/persist.rs` ONLY when the document is non-empty, so a project that never used the Composer resaves byte-diff-free. An emitter contract: `additionalProperties` is not closed (debt D-06). Keys and chords are SPELLED STRINGS on the wire — `Tpc`'s line-of-fifths integer encoding is an implementation detail of `theory/`, and a persisted format that spells `Cb` as `Cb` stays readable, diffable and enharmonically honest.

keys.description: Key spans, sorted by tick, ticks distinct. The first MUST be at tick 0 whenever anything is present. An empty document is valid and means 'no harmonic claim yet'; readers treat it as C major.

chords.description: Chord regions, sorted by tick and non-overlapping. Gaps are legal and meaningful — a bar with no chord makes no harmonic claim, and the palette falls back to the key there.

tick.description: Integer ticks at the project PPQ (debt D-02: no musical position is ever in seconds).

key.description: Canonical key: `"<tonic> <scaleId>"`, e.g. "C ionian", "Bb aeolian", "E harmonicMinor". Parsed by `theory::scale::Key::parse`, which also accepts friendly forms ("Bb major", "f# minor", bare "C") on input but never emits them.

lengthTicks.description: Length in ticks. Zero is rejected by `HarmonyDoc::validate` — a zero-length region would break every `chord_at` lookup.

chord.description: Chord symbol, parsed and emitted by `theory::chord::Chord`. Root + quality suffix, with an optional slash bass. Emitted suffixes are the canonical ones (`m7b5`, `maj7`, `7sus4`, `dim7`, …); aliases (`-7`, `M7`, `ø`, `°`) are accepted on input only.
